verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents a programmatic Domains API and `gddy` CLI covering availability search, registration, renewal, transfers, lock control and DNS. A power user could script these per-domain calls across a portfolio, and rate-limit headers support that kind of looping. However, no evidence shows native bulk endpoints or multi-domain batch operations. Every register, renew or transfer also needs its own quoteToken, so 'at once' depends on custom scripting. Missing for 10: native bulk/batch endpoints for search, registration, renewal and transfer; explicit nameserver-change operations; multi-domain UI or CLI batch commands; independent hands-on corroboration of portfolio-scale use.
